_doc: BLE tag zones for forklifts (tag TD-FL01 = forklift FL-01). Measured on site with the
calibration helper at /device: stand at each spot with the tag, capture, paste the result here,
restart the backend. One gateway only measures distance, so pick spots at clearly different
distances from the board, nearest first. A forklift is placed in the first zone whose
min_rssi_dbm its smoothed RSSI reaches. Empty zones = BLE tracking off (nothing is placed).
window: readings in the moving average (scans are every 2 s).
stable_s: a new zone must hold this long before the forklift switches (hysteresis).
lost_after_s: a tag not seen this long hands its forklift back to manual control.
